name: Tsuki no Hikari, Taiyou no Kage -Another Moon-
source:
Maki goes to school, but her fiance is already chosen by parents. She loves a boy at school, but she starts to doubt his feelings during her transfer study in the United Kingdom. Will she fall under charm of foreigners or stay true to distant relations love? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
